annotations.title: Search places to stay, eat and do

description: Search the member places to stay, eat and do in Keswick and the northern Lake District — the only area this registry covers — from a question in the user's own words. Returns ranked places, recommended areas, and — when you pass `stay` (or the question states dates and party) — live availability and the price for the whole stay from each business's own booking system, whose offer ids go straight to book_venue. Call this rather than answering from memory whenever the user wants a real, bookable place in this area, or a current price. Use match_venues instead when the user names a specific place. Structured JSON, not a rendered UI.

assumeParty.description: Optional. The party to check live availability for when the question names dates but nobody is counted ("next weekend"). The question's own party, `party` or `stay` always wins; `meta.queryValues.guests` stays empty, so the answer can say the party was assumed.

pets.description: Number of dogs (or other pets) travelling. Only stays whose booking system prices them are offered, at that price.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of results to return.

party.description: Who is travelling, when known without dates (children change what suits). Ignored when `stay` carries its own party.

pets.description: Number of dogs (or other pets) travelling. Only stays whose booking system prices them are offered, at that price.

query.description: The question: `text` in natural language, with optional `filter` to narrow results (catalogue, section, category, type, place).

filter.description: Optional dot-path field filters; each value is an array of strings (OR within a field), e.g. {"tags":["spa"]}.

text.description: Natural-language query, e.g. "boutique hotels in London with a spa".

render.description: Ask for layout hints alongside the results. Delivery (one body or a stream) is chosen by the Accept header, not here.

a2ui.description: Also return `ui`: an A2UI surface for the same results. A hint; the results are complete without it.

catalogs.description: A2UI catalog ids the caller can render.

stay.description: Optional. When given, results are grounded in live availability and offers for these dates and party. When absent, dates and party written in the question still apply. A dog the question names ("with our dog") joins a party that does not count pets.

pets.description: Number of dogs (or other pets) travelling. Only stays whose booking system prices them are offered, at that price.

name: discover_venues
